finding.text: Nobody has a record that the tests pass. The brief (ask 6) says `roles.test.mjs` and the Servex agent tests must pass, but the task folder has no `task.jsonl` and no log line that names a test result. Re-running here: `roles.test.mjs` passes (35 checks); `path-mastermind.test.mjs` cannot run in worktree qf-3, because `Servex/node_modules` is missing there (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` from `Agents.js`). Run the test in a worktree that has its own node_modules (`Server/worktree-up.mjs`) and log the result.

The final report that ask 5 requires is missing. Ask 5 says to state in plain sentences exactly what changed in `roles.js` and the singleton code. The task folder (`page.jsonl`, `session.jsonl`, `past-work.md`, `requirements.md`) has no landing line or outcome. Its last entry says the agent is queued at the spawn gate, and nothing names branch `worktree/qf-3` (commits ab0a949e0..dae5d6aac) as ready to merge. A fresh agent could not continue from this folder alone.

`Servex/agents/policy.js:16` was on the brief's list of files to check, but it was left unchanged. `SERVEX_ID` still matches only `ai-system-mastermind`, `mastermind-servex` and `servex-mastermind`. So the new `mastermind-ai` gets `kind()` "worker" and `is_mastermind()` true, while the old id it replaces got "servex". Either add `mastermind-ai` to the regex or write down why it should be treated as an ordinary mastermind now.
`public/framework/ai/doc/models.md:34` still lists `ai-system-mastermind` as one of the role rows in `roles.js`. That row no longer exists; the word is now an alias of `mastermind`.

The lead paragraph of `Servex/agents/doc/lifecycle.md:272` still says "a standing agent gets a fresh session about once a day". The new bullet just below it (line 274) says renewal is gone, so the two lines contradict each other.

A spawn with both `path` and `task` now loses the readme chain for the task folder. `directory_of` returns `spec.path` first (`Agents.js` ~1018), and when the path is loaded into the system prompt, `dir` is null, so nothing is added to the first message. That is probably intended, but it is not written down in the "Spawned at a path" section of `roles/mastermind.md`.

A `path` that does not exist makes `spawn` throw, from `dir_of` (`directory.js:52`). Ask 3 describes a different behaviour: log `ok:false` and tell the agent. A loud failure is reasonable here; say so in the docs so the next reader doesn't take it for a bug.

In `Server/role-spend.mjs:16`, the prefix `mastermind-ai` also matches any future mastermind whose path leaf starts with `ai-` (for example `mastermind-ai-sessions`), because `ids_for` matches `prefix + "-…"`. That is harmless today.

The live `ai-system-mastermind` session keeps its id, but its next resume gets a new system prompt. `Agent.role_prompt()` (Agents.js ~1283) now builds it from `roles/mastermind.md` plus the path blocks for `public/framework/ai/`, instead of the old role file. This is the right text. Still, the brief said "do not touch it", so mention it when the branch merges.
